headline: Last session: Indian markets traded with a focus on crude oil and gold prices while preparing for next week's triggers.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 22 September.

why: Tata Trusts declared the reappointment of N Chandrasekaran as Tata Sons Chairman legally invalid.
Ashiana Housing announced plans to invest Rs 1,000 crore in land acquisition this fiscal year.
Geopolitical tensions in West Asia and crude oil prices are expected to drive market sentiment.
ACFI is seeking a government scheme to reduce dependence on China for crop protection.
whatHappening: The Indian stock market is closed for the weekend and will reopen on Tuesday, September 22.
NSE shareholders have retained significant stakes even after tendering shares in the recent Offer for Sale.
Gwalior is set to host Asia's first telecom manufacturing zone with interest from 24 companies.
Analysts are monitoring GIFT Nifty and other Asian markets for cues on the next trading session.
summary:
The Indian market is currently closed for a weekend break and will resume trading on Tuesday.
Key news includes a significant boardroom dispute at Tata Trusts and Ashiana Housing's Rs 1,000 crore investment plan.
Investors are also keeping a close watch on global factors such as West Asia tensions and crude oil fluctuations.
